title: ByteDance Discusses Training a Large Model with Over 5 Trillion Parameters, Scale May Exceed the Largest Existing Model in China

content_html:
According to "LanDian LatePost," ByteDance is discussing the training of a large language model with parameters exceeding 500 billion. If ultimately launched, its scale will surpass Alibaba's Tongyi Qwen3.8-Max with 240 billion parameters and Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 with 280 billion parameters, becoming the largest known parameter model in China. However, the project is still in the early stage, and it is not yet determined whether it will be officially released.

The report states that the model is planned to be led by Xiang Liang, head of ByteDance's Seed Foundation, and cooperated with Shen Ke, who is responsible for pre-training data of large language models. Around this project, the Seed team is carrying out organizational adjustments, including redefining R&D responsibilities and optimizing resource allocation to support the training of ultra-large-scale models.

According to the information, Xiang Liang and Shen Ke are both key members of ByteDance's artificial intelligence and large model development system. Both of them came from ByteDance's core "search, advertising, and recommendation" technology system. Xiang Liang graduated from the University of Science and Technology of China with a bachelor's degree and earned his doctorate at the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences. He joined ByteDance in 2016 and was previously in charge of the machine learning platform AML team, later serving as the head of the Douyin large model Foundation team. Shen Ke joined ByteDance after graduating from Tsinghua University in 2018 and currently mainly oversees pre-training data-related work for large language models.

As AI manufacturers both domestically and internationally continue to expand the scale of their models and compete in areas such as training data, computing power, and infrastructure, the development of ultra-large-scale models has become an important direction for leading companies to explore general artificial intelligence capabilities. ByteDance's move also reflects that the competition in large models in China is further extending from application innovation to fundamental model capability construction.

content_html_zh:
据《蓝点晚报》报道，字节跳动正在讨论参数超5000亿的大型语言模型的训练。 如果最终上线，其规模将超过阿里巴巴的统一Qwen3.8-Max（2400亿参数）和Moonshot AI的Kimi K3（2800亿参数），成为国内已知参数最大的模型。 不过该项目仍处于早期阶段，目前尚未确定是否会正式发布。

报道称，该模型计划由字节跳动种子基金会负责人项亮牵头，与负责大语言模型预训练数据的沉科合作。 围绕该项目，Seed团队正在进行组织调整，包括重新明确研发职责、优化资源配置，以支持超大规模模型的训练。

资料显示，项亮和申科都是字节跳动人工智能和大模型开发体系的关键成员。 两者都来自字节跳动的核心“搜索、广告、推荐”技术体系。 项亮毕业于中国科学技术大学，获学士学位，中科院自动化研究所获博士学位。 他于2016年加入字节跳动，此前负责机器学习平台AML团队，后担任抖音大模型基金会团队负责人。 申科2018年从清华大学毕业后加入字节跳动，目前主要负责大语言模型的预训练数据相关工作。

随着国内外人工智能厂商不断扩大模型规模，在训练数据、算力、基础设施等方面展开竞争，超大规模模型的开发成为头部企业探索通用人工智能能力的重要方向。 字节跳动此举也反映出，中国大模型的竞争正在进一步从应用创新延伸到基础模型能力建设。
